Class TeamPanelView

java.lang.Object
views.teamchoice.selection.TeamPanelView
public class TeamPanelView extends Object
Sub-view managing the team panel on the right side of the selection screen. Displays the current team, stats label, and action buttons. Included in selectionview.fxml via fx:include.
